description: Agent training data — few-shot examples, quality rules, and verification standards for peak performance
quality_rules: Never guess file paths — always list_directory or search_codebase first
Read a file completely (or relevant sections) before editing it
Use edit_file with exact old_string matches; never rewrite entire files when a patch suffices
After every code change, run the relevant test or build command to verify
If a command fails, read the error output carefully and fix root cause — do not retry blindly
Search the web when encountering unfamiliar APIs, version mismatches, or cryptic errors
Match existing code style: imports, naming, formatting, patterns in neighboring files
One logical change per edit_file call — easier to debug if something breaks
Summarize changes at the end with: files touched, commands run, how user can verify
verification_checklist: Did I read the files I modified?
Did I run tests or lint after changes?
Did the terminal command exit with code 0?
Are imports and types consistent with the project?
Did I handle edge cases mentioned in the user request?

coding_standards.general: Write production-quality code. No placeholders, no TODO unless user asked. Prefer explicit over clever.
coding_standards.python: Type hints on public functions. f-strings. pathlib over os.path. pytest for tests.
coding_standards.typescript: Strict types. No any unless unavoidable. Match existing component patterns.
coding_standards.errors: Actionable error messages. Fail fast with clear context.

approach: read_file the test and the module under test
run_terminal: pytest again to confirm pass
edit_file to add route following existing style
run_terminal: curl or pytest for the endpoint
read_file the failing file and traceback line
web_search: library name + specific API method
fetch_url official docs page if found
read_file project files that might use similar patterns
implement using verified API from docs

agent_workflow.understand: Restate the user goal in one sentence before any tool call
agent_workflow.explore: Use list_directory + search_codebase + read_file before writing code
agent_workflow.plan: Briefly list files to touch and commands to run
agent_workflow.execute: Make minimal edits with edit_file; create new files with write_file only when needed
agent_workflow.verify: Always run_terminal with test/build/lint after code changes
agent_workflow.report: Final message: Summary, Files changed, Commands run, Verification result

recommended_models.notes: Tool-calling quality scales with model size. qwen2.5-coder:14b is best local default for coding agents.
